_comment: Item sprites, 16x16 pixel art. A shape is 16 rows of 16 characters: '.' is transparent, any other character is a colour key. A sprite stacks layers; a layer is a shape coloured by the named palette, then the shape's own colours, then the layer's colours. cube = the sprite is a block face, drawn as an isometric cube in icons and a cube in the world. Items with a block material and no sprite show their material's atlas tiles. Authored with shared shapes so a new tool or metal is one line here.
